records.explanation: None of the listed tables (intermediate.int_customers, intermediate.int_invoices, marts.deal_to_cash, marts.receivables_aging, marts.revenue_by_customer, or the staging tables) has a credit score column, so the warehouse has no data that could give Northwind Logistics' credit score; the closest available fields are receivables aging and open balances in marts.receivables_aging, which are not a credit score.

None of the listed tables has a salesperson or user-owner column: staging.stg_deals, marts.deal_to_cash and the invoice, order and payment tables only carry partner, customer and deal fields, so the warehouse cannot say who closed each deal.

Gross margin needs cost of goods sold, and no table in the warehouse has a cost column: marts and intermediate tables hold only revenue, invoice, payment and open amounts, and staging holds order and invoice totals with no product cost or purchase cost.

The warehouse has no support ticket data: none of the listed intermediate, marts, or staging tables (customers, invoices, deals, orders, partners, payments) record tickets, so the count of Acme Corporation's support tickets cannot be determined.

The warehouse has no billing schedule or forecast: invoices only record past or current issue and due dates, and the nearest proxy, staging.stg_deals expected_revenue for deals with closed_on in November 2026, is pipeline value and would not show what will actually be billed.
